_purpose: Cross-package fixture (BUILD.md S1: opengrid/ogsim share no code, only the wire/id scheme): opengrid.fleet.seed.build_topology and ogsim.fleet.state.build_fleet_state must both reproduce this exact hub/bank id, zone and dual-unit assignment for the same base+zone_blocks config. Read by orchestrator/tests/unit/fleet/test_seed_zone_blocks.py and integration-sims/tests/test_fleet_zone_blocks.py. Computed by hand from the documented rule (see ZoneBlockConfig's docstring in both config modules), not by running either package's code, so a shared formula bug can't produce a fixture that fools both tests.
note: LZ_CPS is disabled, so it reserves NO ids: only 8 hubs / 3 banks total, and bank-002 is LZ_AEN (not LZ_CPS), proving a disabled block is skipped rather than reserving a numbering gap.
